name: docs-doctor
label: Docs doctor
description: Check authored Modus content against the live schemas, and check the shipped documentation against the code it claims to cover. Answers "is what I just wrote actually correct" instead of "does the doc say so".

inputs.name: target
inputs.label: What should be checked?
inputs.placeholder: a profile path to validate, a doc id to audit, or leave blank for a full sweep...

schema_keys.description: List the keys a live Zod schema actually accepts, with best-effort types and optionality. Use this instead of trusting prose documentation about fields.

validate.description: Validate a JSON document against a live schema. Pass either `content` (an inline object) or `path` (a JSON file relative to the project cwd). Reports schema errors AND unknown keys, which the schemas themselves accept silently.

doc_drift.description: Audit shipped docs against the source they declare in `covers:` frontmatter — missing source files, and schema keys the covering doc never mentions. Omit docId to sweep every doc.
